data.long_meaning: Harshu is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a male name that means 'harsh, austere'. In Hindu mythology, Harshu can be associated with Lord Shiva, who is known for his harsh and austere nature. The name Harshu carries the meaning “Harsh, Austere” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harshu usually hope their child will grow to embody harsh, austere and live with faith, good character and purpose.
